files.title: File:Citizens Bank Building, 2nd Street and Putnam Street, Marietta, OH (54322195562).jpg
files.author: Warren LeMay from Chicago, IL, United States
files.caption: Built in 1928, this Art Deco-style building was built for Citizens Bank.  The building is clad in bedford limestone with arched window bays, fluted piers, decorative reliefs, metal spandrel panels with decorative floral motifs, and a granite base.  The building is a contributing structure in the Marietta Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974, and expanded to its present size in 2001.
